## Ignore Visual Studio temporary files, build results, and
## files generated by popular Visual Studio add-ons.

# User-specific files
*.rsuser
*.suo
*.user
*.userosscache
*.sln.docstates

# Build results
[Dd]ebug/
[Rr]elease/
x64/
x86/
[Aa][Rr][Mm]/
[Aa][Rr][Mm]64/
bld/
[Bb]in/
[Oo]bj/
[Ll]og/

# Visual Studio cache files
.vs/

# MSTest test Results
[Tt]est[Rr]esult*/
[Bb]uild[Ll]og.*

# NCrunch
_NCrunch_*
.*crunch*.local.xml

# Visual Studio profiler
*.psess
*.vsp
*.vspx
*.sap

# Others
*.dll
*.exe
*.pdb
*.cache
*.log
*.db
*.mdf
*.ldf
*.ndf

# Node modules (if you use React/Angular with ASP.NET)
node_modules/

# Publish output
publish/
*.pubxml
*.publishproj

# Backup & package files
*.bak
*.tmp
*.svclog
*.nupkg
*.snupkg
*.zip
*.tar.gz
